requirements.title: Bounded continuous discovery and candidate admission
requirements.source_claim: A radar may discover repositories/models/data and adapt useful functions into a unified Protocol/SPI.
requirements.real_problem: Popularity, license labels, AST slicing, LLM rewriting and one sandbox run do not establish rights, fit, correctness or production readiness.
requirements.state_machine: RADAR_OBSERVATION → EXACT_SOURCE_CAPTURED → PROVENANCE_PRECHECK → FIT_ANALYSIS → ISOLATED_CANDIDATE → CONTROLS/BENCHMARK → SHADOW_REVIEW → HUMAN_ADMIT | REJECT | DEFER
positive_controls: matched repeated benchmark includes failures and uncertainty
blockers: owner Protocol/SPI and benchmark not bound
requirements.next_transition: Emit A5 owner packet and preserve discovery as advisory.

requirements.title: Authenticated, replay-safe, durable webhook ingress
requirements.source_claim: GitLab/Jira issue webhooks may trigger background Agent workflows.
requirements.real_problem: FastAPI BackgroundTasks is process-local and can lose admitted work; provider auth and replay semantics are not generic.
requirements.state_machine: RAW_EVENT_RECEIVED → AUTHENTICITY/REPLAY_CHECKED → NORMALIZED → DEDUPE_BOUND → DURABLE_INBOX_COMMITTED → TASK_ADMITTED
positive_controls: process crash after HTTP 202 does not lose committed work
duplicate/reordered delivery does not duplicate task
requirements.next_transition: Route A6 ingress contract to Bettor and provider adapters.

requirements.title: Idempotent effect ledger and remote writeback reconciliation
requirements.source_claim: Only validated results should be written back to issue/project systems.
requirements.real_problem: At-least-once execution can duplicate comments or labels; timeouts create unknown effects that cannot be retried blindly.
requirements.state_machine: WRITE_INTENT_PREPARED → CAPABILITY/VERSION/GATE_CHECKED → EFFECT_RESERVED → EXECUTED → REMOTE_READBACK → COMMITTED | UNKNOWN_EFFECT | COMPENSATION_REQUIRED | HUMAN_ESCALATE
blockers: effect ledger and provider write adapters not bound
requirements.next_transition: Route A6 writeback packet and later compile exact P7 commands.

requirements.title: Bounded retry, escalation, Human admission and rollback
requirements.source_claim: Failed gates should retry with targeted feedback, then escalate to a Human after a bound limit.
requirements.real_problem: Retry success, issue closure, CI green or model agreement cannot authorize release or irreversible actions.
requirements.state_machine: FAILURE_CLASSIFIED → BOUNDED_RETRY → CLEANUP_VERIFIED → LOCAL_HANDOFF | HUMAN_ADMIT_REQUIRED → RELEASED | ROLLED_BACK
blockers: canonical profile handoff items not yet compiled
requirements.next_transition: After X/D convergence, append exact profile items to the single Local Handoff queue.
